sn35.158:1.1: Cakkhum bhikkhave yoniso manasi karotha || cakkhaniccataṃ ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha ||
sn35.158:1.2: Cakkhum bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasi karonto cakkhaniccataṃ ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto cakkhusmim pi nibbindati ||
sn35.158:1.8: Jivham bhikkhave yoniso manasi karotha || jivhāniccataṃ ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha ||
sn35.158:1.9: jivham bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasi karotha || jivhāniccataṃ ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha || jivham bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasi karonto jivhāniccataṃ ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto jivhāya nibbindati || ||
sn35.158:1.14: Manam bhikkhave yoniso manasi karotha || manāniccataṃ ca yathābhūtam samanupassatha || ||
sn35.158:1.15: Manam bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasi karonto manāniccataṃ ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto manasmimpi nibbindati ||
